# chalk_offline_store_connection (Data Source)

Reads a Chalk offline store connection by ID. **Does not** surface snowflake password / private_key (Sensitive on the resource).

**Required permissions:** `deploy.read`



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID the connection is scoped to.
- `id` (String) Offline store connection identifier.

### Read-Only

- `bigquery` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bigquery))
- `iceberg` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--iceberg))
- `kind` (String) Underlying backend: `snowflake`, `bigquery`, or `iceberg`.
- `name` (String)
- `snowflake` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snowflake))

<a id="nestedatt--bigquery"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bigquery`

Read-Only:

- `dataset_id` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Nested Schema for `iceberg`

Read-Only:

- `glue_s3` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--iceberg--glue_s3))

<a id="nestedatt--iceberg--glue_s3"></a>
### Nested Schema for `iceberg.glue_s3`

Read-Only:

- `glue_database_name` (String)
- `s3_bucket` (String)
